assembly-tools.description: Local assembly tool windows communicate with the owning workspace and preserve dirty drafts on native close requests.

detached-tools.description: Detached results and probe windows can exchange bounded UI state with the main workspace only.

main-window.description: The main SPIKE workspace may create and communicate with presentation-only detached tool windows.

report-preview.description: The engineering report preview receives parent-owned HTML and can request print or export actions.
